test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 5 times the present age of Sujatha is 5 years more than 2 times the present age of Vanita. After 4 years, 3 times the age of Vanita will be 8 years less than 5 times the age of Sujatha. The age of Vanita is k years more than that of Sujatha. What is the value of k?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Sujatha**'s age be S and **Vanita**'s age be V.

Equation 1: 5S − 2V = 5

Equation 2 (after 4 years): 5(S + 4) − 3(V + 4) = 8 ⇒ 5S − 3V = 0

From Eq 2: 5S = 3V. Substitute in Eq 1: 3V − 2V = 5 ⇒ V = 5.

Since 5S = 3(5), S = 3. Difference k = V − S = 5 − 3 = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Relation between present ages and ages after 4 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a7b05e9692ac2a537c80dd4b32921fd3a68fbd021d3472c6323cc24dcef1a4b.png] 

⇒ Let **Sujatha**'s present age = S and **Vanita**'s present age = V.

⇒ From the first condition: 5S = 2V + 5 — (i)

⇒ Age after 4 years: Sujatha = S + 4, Vanita = V + 4.

⇒ From the second condition: 3(V + 4) = 5(S + 4) − 8

⇒ 3V + 12 = 5S + 20 − 8

⇒ 3V + 12 = 5S + 12

⇒ 3V = 5S — (ii)

⇒ Substitute 5S = 3V from (ii) into (i):

⇒ 3V = 2V + 5

⇒ V = 5 years

⇒ Now, 5S = 3(5) ⇒ S = 3 years

⇒ Difference k = V − S = 5 − 3 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Property

The difference between the ages of two persons remains **constant** at any point in time.

Linear Equations in Two Variables

Problems involving two people and two conditions are best solved using **substitution** or **elimination** methods.

Ratio of Ages

If the ratio of ages is given, use a common multiplier 'x' to represent actual ages and solve the linear equation.</p
